description: Machine-readable expected outcome for every fixture in this directory; verify-fixtures.mjs fails (non-zero exit) on any mismatch. `type` selects the check: "bundle" (one Release Evidence Bundle against release-evidence-bundle.schema.json + personal-dimension scan), "event" (one release event against release-event.schema.json + the scan), "event-collection" (an array of events checked together: schema per event, then the transition-graph fold, the same-bundle_digest-per-release invariant, and the dangling-rollback check -- the cross-record rules no single-record validation can express, same convention as release-observation/v0's "collection"). PROVENANCE: accept-bundle-spec-lane-0-6-0 carries REAL values measured 2026-08-22 (git commit/tree from the v0.6.0 tag, npm tarball sha256 fetched and hashed live, recipe/toolchain digests hashed from the tag's docs/releasing.md and package.json). accept-bundle-static-site-synthetic and every event fixture are SYNTHETIC shapes -- the static-site values are placeholders to be replaced with real measured ones by the first Pages deploy-adapter exercise, which is also the gate for freezing v1 (re-plan 2026-08-22).
